notes.title: ENCASED — PATCH 3 HOTFIX 2: Critical bugs, cosmetic fixes and more
notes.content:
Patch 3 saw the introduction of a large crashed transport plane event, gamepad support and a completely overhauled in-game vehicle system. We fixed some of the remaining bugs in Hotfix 1; only the most significant edits remained, which took us almost 2 months to implement. Hotfix 2 - released today - includes fixes for critical bugs, localization fixes and several UI improvements.

[h2]Critical Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some vignettes would ‘break’ the game when a player tried to go back to previous slides
[*] Fixed the dialogue logic with Audrey (after the Parasites quest); if the anomalous essence was stolen and the player tried to receive a reward, the dialogue would freeze
[*] Fixed incorrect loading of the Fops Camp location, when one of the inhabitants of the camp occupied the spawn point of the player's car
[*] Fixed the display for Atilla in characters’ hands and in the inventory menu
[*] Fixed a bug where the companion's weapon ended up in a player's inventory when the companion died or left the team. It was previously impossible to remove the equipped companion’s weapon
[/list]
[h2]Important Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem with the new markers appearing on the map related to the MTT Eldorado event 
[*] Fixed context menu; now you can inspect an item in any situation (even if it is inside a container), an NPC’s inventory, in the barter menu, etc.
[/list]
[h2]Localisation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed localisation of the text appearing upon receiving a new perk
[*] Fixed some buttons localisation
[*] Fixed incorrect translation of the Credits tab in the main menu; it was previously named About
[*] Removed incorrect text in the Settings tab
[*] Fixed description of Attack Reroll perk in French and German localisation
[/list]
[h2]Cosmetic Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed line wrapping in feedback window
[*] Fixed layout of the Leave Location window; with an increased font size, the text on the buttons previously did not fit into the line
[*] Fixed layout for the elements of the global map; with an increased font size, info on travel time previously did not fit into the line
[*] Fixed incorrect colors for skill points required to unlock a new Abilities tier
[/list]



[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: ENCASED - PATCH 3, HOTFIX 1: Gamepad tweaks, critical bug fixes and cosmetics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a02136a896439f3cb85533d1606b8bca0900abf.png[/img]

The last patch was a real test for the team – we’ve added gamepad support, new content, expanded on car mechanics, and added a Linux version. And, of course, bug fixes.

In today's hotfix, we've addressed a few bugs that have been discovered, and also made some cosmetic changes to the game regarding sound and level design. The list of fixes and improvements is provided below.

[b]Critical errors[/b]
[list][*] Fixed infinite start of the battle on the Desert Road location
[*] Fixed inability to initiate dialogue with the air duct on the -1 floor of the C12-Nashville facility
[*] Fixed non-working scissor lift at Magellan Station - Residential Level
[/list]

[b]Gamepads[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue related to interacting with items on the belt when near interactive location objects
[*] The character that was controlled by the player earlier stops running in the indicated direction when choosing another character
[*] Fixed problems with selecting the girder using analog stick at the Camp of the First Settlers location
[/list]

[b]Locations[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect lighting at the Stone Forest location
[*] Fixed incorrect lighting at the Magellan Station - Warehouse and Parking Lot location
[*] Fixed patency at the Destroyed Concord Station location
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect sound effects in the dialogues at the Kaleidoscope Bunker location
[*] Vignettes with cars now have sound
[*] Vignettes with Ursula now have sound
[*] Vignettes with additional automotive content now have sound
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed absence of damage for squad members that are outside the scope of the Church implant in the Camp of the First Settlers location
[*] Fixed a situation where each tick of damage caused the companion to say an “injured” line
[/list]
Changed how companions auto-resurrect after battles in Story difficulty mode
Fixed incorrect display of brass knuckles in a character's hand when switching weapons

notes.title: ENCASED - PATCH 3: CARS, A PLANE IN DESERT AND GAMEPAD SUPPORT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/a2869b141fc86c785303c1db97b09d23a725a86d.png[/img]

The full version of Encased was released in September and we’ve since introduced several hotfixes -  and a couple of major patches - where we thoroughly worked on the UI, optimisation, level design and other aspects of the game. But all of this (with the exception of the special Halloween patch) was related to the content that was already in the game. That's great, but how about something new? Such as what we promised during our kickstarter campaign.

With this in mind, we started developing Patch 3. Today we are happy to present it to you and let you know what awaits you in the first (but not last!) large-scale Encased update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/39495a6c6d775ab54fec5377370e1b0be48a5d5c.png[/img]

[h1]A new adventure and cars[/h1]

Before the Spire Station was built, cargo was delivered under the Dome by aircraft. One such aircraft - a decommissioned military transport callsigned Eldorado - made a hard landing in a mountainous area and was abandoned. A few years later, the plane which was devoid of life, began to broadcast strange signals... You’ll need to find out what is happening at the crash site and what fate befell the scientific group that went to investigate the plane shortly after it crashed. Oh and, by the way, on board the plane you can find a unique piece of clothing for your character as well as tons of loot.

We have redesigned the game's transport system; players can now steal almost any car (except those that will never run again). Having a car brings on many changes: not only can you navigate the map faster, but you also unlock new encounters, many of which can lead to highly unpredictable outcomes.

And conversely, we’ve added a little more predictability to random events in which you can encounter travelers named after kickstarter backers; as of now, if you convince someone to join one of the factions, upon arriving at the settlement, you will most certainly meet them, and some of such characters will become merchants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/a188cb6940cfd28481fcf6663fcd5e305153f9b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes, gamepad and Linux version[/h1]

We have long promised to add gamepad support to the game and spent a lot of time and effort on its implementation. Additional options have been added along with the gamepad and now you can adjust the font size - or enable high contrast mode – which will make the game more accessible to play on a large monitor or TV. Or, for that matter, on a small Steam Deck display.

We also released a Linux version of the game and fixed a lot of bugs, errors and polished some minor rough edges – the fixes were so numerous that we decided not to make a list at all this time. Believe us, you will still see enough of them, because we do not plan to abandon Encased, and in the near future a lot of new and interesting things await you.

Thank you for your support and please stay tuned.



[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: CRONUS Weekly 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Hello, we hope that you’ve had a fantastic New Year and are all set to venture  under the Dome in the company of your faithful companions. Today's issue will be short but very important.

[h1]Development update[/h1]

[previewyoutube=OSMvolpEFAc;full][/previewyoutube]

We know we promised the patch in late December but unfortunately -  due to technical reasons - we had to postpone the release until January. But this month we will definitely have new content waiting for you. The extra time of development allowed us to polish new locations and mechanics, as well as fix some bugs.

Can't wait to see what new content is waiting for you under the Dome? Then visit our Youtube channel. The latest episode of the development diaries is waiting for your viewers.

[h1]New locations and completely redesigned cars[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5f003d39a25c9c1065f7c1b8226de0d38eed10ae.png[/img]

One of the main changes of the patch will be the new locations;  the Fallen Fortress and the Mysterious Caves. Here you will find new enemies, equipment, treasures and mysteries of the wastelands.

And you will be able to drive away with those riches on completely redesigned transport: you can repair or blow up any vehicle under the Dome and these repaired cars can be used as a personal vehicle. There will be a place to park them in each location.

[h1]Additional settings[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/d465187d26c96e86c18079f99776294f5a46f12f.png[/img]

Players with large monitors will appreciate the new contrast mode and the long-awaited ability to change the font size. You no longer have to strain your eyes to read any text again. Another change - which will please owners of gamepads - is that we fully adapted the interface and added support for hotkeys.

And we’re always in the market to hear your suggestions to improve the game; we’ll try to add what we can.




[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: Upcoming update and gamepad support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! The latest issue of the post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly is, once more, on your screen. Can anyone hear us?

Today we’ll talk about the near-future of Encased.

[h1]December Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/15e8494477e44fa1cdc1632673bd162bb767ad55.jpg[/img]

Employees, winter has arrived. It won't be long before we start preparing for the holidays and most people go on a well-deserved vacation. And to make sure you don't get bored during the break,we'll be releasing another Encased update this year!

We'll tell you more later, but you can expect new locations, enemies, battles, gear and more. We really hope you enjoy it :)

[h1]Gamepad Support[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/766d4d856f3426b81daa9a911ce995ed19244965.jpg[/img]

We've been actively working on full PC gamepad support for the past few months and we're happy to announce that your wait will be over in December.

We have adapted the interface and hotkeys for each panel and will also try to add a special mode with larger font and text contrast.

By the way, if you played on a gamepad in the early access, you should like the fact that now the character will independently bypass minor obstacles. No longer will you cling to small objects in your path.

[h1]Steam Awards[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/d961ccfb6faf18be37485a413bc8cd4bd77d5bca.gif[/img]

Employees, the annual Steam Awards is underway and players have begun to vote for the best games in ten categories. If you had fun under the Dome — please vote for Encased in any of the categories. We'll really appreciate it.




[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: ENCASED - Hotfix 4: End of the Halloween event, minor fixes. What's next?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/6cc886c7ea4ea219f76a7cda2264f35a21ccf4f3.png[/img]

It's been two months since Encased was released. During this time, we have significantly improved stability, added more reputation events, fixed many bugs and typos. We have also published a roadmap for the game’s further development. By New Year, another patch will be released containing special events for vehicles (including Ursula), balance tweaks and a number of "quality of life" changes.

As for today's hotfix, we’ve added a small number of fixes and disabled the Halloween event. Keep in mind that the merchant named Sylvia Halen will be staying in the City and will continue to give rewards in exchange for Cursed Seeds, but the pumpkin-headed skeletons will disappear from the game until next year.

As for the edits made to the game, here is the list:
[list]
[*] Fixed necroids generating a stupefying ‘field of death’
[*] Fixed Church reputation decrease after the death of Victoria Legrand
[*] Fixed infinite gain experience with a fusebox in Magellan reactor section
[*] Fixed button for creating ability shortcuts on the quick access panel
[*] Fixed freezing in the dialogue with bandits at the Roadside Picnic Staging Post during prologue
[*] Expanded ability to use the Stealth Generator on robots and allies
[*] Now you can talk to Lenny after defeating the Afflicted
[*] Fixed navigation routes for new characters in the Desert near Concord location
[*] Localization has been significantly improved
[*] Fixed typos
[/list]

notes.title: ENCASED — Patch 2: a number of bugfixes and the Horrors of the Dome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/b22cb0361801bd1422ee59a8a4445698171560cc.png[/img]

This October turned out very stressful – as we finished work on the latest patch and sat back to relax, a new one was on its way. This time we fixed many bugs and added a special event in honor of All Saints’ Day: the Barrens are now overrun with pumpkin-headed skeletons, and a special merchant was sighted in the City. But, first things first.

[h1]Special Event[/h1]
Sylvia Halen, a promising scientist from the mysterious White Swan station, is on the hunt for the Cursed Seeds – the little-studied relics that can be obtained from the bodies of dead employees. Sylvia does not skimp on rewards: in addition to various chemicals, she will offer the player a unique artifact. The following awaits you in the Halloween event:

— Temporary redesign of old enemies (Skeletons),
— A new relic,
— Festive decor at various locations,
— A new piece of equipment – Pumpkin Helmet, which can be upgraded.

Make haste, as this event will end on November 8th. The special enemies will disappear, but Sylvia will remain in the City and become a regular merchant until exactly next Halloween. You can exchange seeds for rewards at any time.

If you don't want the Halloween DLC to launch and change the game, simply uninstall it. You can find the file in the folder where the game is installed. Here is the exact path to DLC: Encased\Encased_Data\StreamingAssets\DLC\Halloween.DLC

[b][i]For everyone willing to see how the game has changed after the release of the new patch, we will host a stream with the developers. It will start on October 28 at 17:00 UTC (19:00 CEST, 12:00 CDT).[/i][/b]

notes.title: Halloween under the Dome!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/83d3b6df4feec4b5b96632e1fe4321b30ce44c55.png[/img]

Employees: the Dome is once again in danger and it is far more terrifying than any anomaly. On 28 October, the dead will rise from their graves and hunt the living.

Fight the undead and gain cursed seeds for your victories. You can exchange these for a valuable artifact or useful equipment from a new merchant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/e7ac6c9c11d27ffda62baaf964aa2ea53d147199.jpg[/img]

Survivors will receive a unique pumpkin helmet; it can be upgraded up to three levels, using the seeds of the dead and other resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/57b377a71f61f8002455f52c4698e47e07c3f428.jpg[/img]

To get some of the valuable prizes, you will have to meet the Halloween Merchant who is waiting for you in the heart of New Committee City. She sells not only the usual first aid kits and anti-radiation drugs, but also a new valuable artifact available for purchase only in exchange for cursed seeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/76535ffec91956e7805fc5d4dd984987fdeb17e1.jpg[/img]

By the way, the merchant will remain in the world under the Dome even after the Halloween event ends, so if you forget to sell the seeds before the end of the event, fear not. However, the skeletons WILL disappear from the game and you so will not be able to get new seeds once the event ends.

Also, to celebrate Halloween, we'll stream via Steam, showing off new content and trying to answer the most interesting questions. Stream will be held at 19:00 CEST on 28 October. See you there!

notes.title: Encased roadmap!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! The latest issue of the post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly is once again on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

This week, we’ll be telling players what they can expect in the coming months. Short for time? In that case, here's a little road map of the Encased train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/f0cd9d51d20e05f458f0aedac190b4fa1ea0a478.png[/img]

[h1]Halloween[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/55d9f25eb7b02a6f2d5b9a65f00703cc0a2925c1.gif[/img]

Employees: the scariest day of the year, Halloween, is coming. The world of Encased won’t be spared either. Employees will soon have to fight - to the death - with horrible creatures straight from your nightmares.

Defeat new enemies and receive a unique currency, which can be exchanged for new equipment and artifacts from a special merchant. We'll tell and show you more next week.

[h1]New Year Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/93f67dfc54b39188cbd8af89632518a9c298d1e4.png[/img]

New Year's Eve is the time for gifts and holiday festivities. Our team is also preparing a present for you. In December you can expect new random encounters on Ursula, as well as new content that’ll bring even more life under the Dome.

We're also always listening to what players want. Tell us what you'd like to see in the upcoming updates! We'll choose the most popular wishes and try to add them.

[h1]Patch 2[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/d668b5d1367bf5eebf9540532317e36a6f48fca5.gif[/img]

Much of the second patch is still under the veil of secrecy, but we can tell you about some things now. In the second patch there will be a new game mode: Arena. There you will be able to hone your combat skills, try new weapons, team combinations and different builds.

More information will be revealed closer to the patch release. We hope you’ll enjoy it :)

notes.title: ENCASED — PATCH 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/e49aeff7ccdf5374e4d26390f3694d82fa89ed7b.png[/img]

[b]Version number: 1.1.1013.1238[/b]

As you probably already noticed, the work on Patch 1 took a little delay, but there are objective reasons for this – there really are a lot of changes and improvements. In addition to fixing the voiceover, incorrect descriptions, bugs and typos, we focused on improving the user experience: a lot of changes were made to the game interface, balance, mechanics and, of course, optimizations – now the game runs faster and a little more stable. This is partly attributable to you, Dear Players, as many errors in the game have been fixed thanks to your bug reports.

We also listen closely to the suggestions you offer across our social networks. Thank you for your words of support and well-reasoned criticism. And above all, thank you for staying with us – it matters a lot to us.

notes.title: New, upcoming and well forgotten!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! Once again, the latest post-apocalyptic CRONUS weekly is on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

This week you’ll learn when you can expect the first post-release patch, as well as a couple of mechanics that new players might not have noticed.

[h1]First patch[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/fb9a2ed62d2a0e2d5a1ec9920b847aca6cd62fcb.gif[/img]

Employees, our team is working tirelessly on the technical state of the game.

Next week, on 14 October, you can expect the first post-release patch: it will fix the difficult bugs that required a lot of time to work on, as well as fix the texture quality degradation, improve the interface and add some other nice changes.

We have also been reading the feedback carefully and some of the changes were made thanks to you and your support.

By the way, did you know that in Encased you can hide dynamite in your enemy's pockets?

[h1]Squad management[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/dfd96b2415da8d103950d89a0a47a4239e225287.gif[/img]

Employees, did you know that each character in your squad can be controlled separately?

To do so, simply detach the portraits from each other in the upper left corner. That way you can set sophisticated ambushes, explore dangerous terrain, and do other not-so-legal things.

[h1]Dismantling[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/83768ae9ed87a43f87d2799a25ae62e3d7319153.gif[/img]

Overwhelmed by inventory, short on resources, or just want to make a little extra money? By increasing your survival skill to 30, you'll be able to dismantle items on locations, as well as unnecessary equipment from your inventory. Turn junk into useful resources in just a few clicks.




[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: CRONUS weekly is back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! Once again, the latest post-apocalyptic CRONUS weekly is on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

Today let's talk about post-release updates under the Dome, unprecedented community support, and, of course, plans for the future.

[h1]Custom portraits[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/661391dd516fa63c5e114d1c3aa72db0754364a7.gif[/img]

Custom portraits were probably the most anticipated innovation of the game. Now each of you can add your own photo or art to the game. Game also supports transparent images, so the most skillful of you can add portraits without backgrounds.

Our team is very interested in what you ended up using in the game as a portrait, so feel free to share with us :)

[h1]More than 2000 reviews![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7d950b243a2ebc48e7bb6be954928ff2071ed8a2.png[/img]

Thanks to your support, Encased already has over 2,000 reviews on Steam, 80% of which are positive! Our team wants to sincerely thank you for your support and we’ll try to continue surprising our community with interesting game updates.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/6cb3391fc0ff43c85315e86cd63bd9b8335d6d68.gif[/img]

Speaking of updates. Even though we haven't released a new hotfix this week, that doesn't mean that the work on bugs is over. It's only the beginning. For the past three weeks we have been carefully collecting your feedback and will try to fix not only the bugs that need a lot of time, but also take into account your wishes, such as new hairstyles and other improvements to the game.

notes.title: ENCASED — Hotfix 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/4de6d4fc897a9b383963ccdacfc80d8b6c401efd.png[/img]

More than two weeks have passed since Encased came out. We are continuing to actively work on the game and develop additional content (which we will announce separately), finalize controversial issues and, of course, read your reports and fix bugs.

However, today's hotfix is ​​special: not only have we eliminated a number of problems, but we’ve also added the function that you have been asking for - the ability to select a custom portrait for the protagonist. The game supports * .jpg and * .png formats, however, we recommend using * .png with transparency so that the background of the location is displayed behind your character's back.

[b]Warning: fix descriptions may contain plot spoilers![/b]

[h1]Localization and Voiceover[/h1]
[list]
[*] Numerous fixes for Chinese (Traditional, Simplified) and Japanese localizations
[*] Fixed Sparrow lines not matching voice overs
[*] Removed Greeting and Goodbye voiceover for Meatball
[*] Removed Greetings and Goodbyes if the narrator is disabled in the settings
[*] Fixed voiceover for Clara Morgan's Greeting
[/list]
[h1]Text[/h1]
[list]
[*] Description of the Point-Blank Shot ability has been updated - now it is indicated that it does not apply to large creatures (entities with Immense status)
[*] Description of the Wrench weapon has been updated - now it is indicated that it requires the Throw a Wrench ability to use it
[*] Fixed the description of the Flurry of Punches ability
[*] Fixed description of the "Golden Ticket" relic
[*] Fixed bugs in dialogues with Louise Decker-Schultz and Kurt Spengler
[*] Fixed bugs in Tkachenko's journal
[*] Fixed narrator nodes in Victoria Legrand's trailer
[/list]
[h1]Graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added additional artwork for the Maelstrom Church finale
[*] Fixed monitors displaying over the "Fog of War"
[/list]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to upload custom portraits for your character
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the displaying of the Crime Committed icon
[*] Fixed incorrect displaying of player's equipment when opening a container with a companion - now it is marked as equipped.
[/list]
[h1]Levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved visual effects at the start of the battle with the necroid boss in Campbell bunker
[*] Fixed camera bounds at Bradbury Station location
[*] Fixed camera bounds at wandering traders' camp locations
[*] Fixed camera bounds at Magellan Station – Administration location
[*] Fixed passage to lower drains in the Nashville sewers
[*] Fixed passability at Magellan Station – Administration location
[*] Fixed camera bounds at Nashville Cave location
[*] Fixed camera bounds and lighting at Crossroads location 
[*] Fixed camera bounds, moved the wall in the toilet, fixed positions of using the sinks at Magellan Station – Residential Level
[*] Removed Invisible boxes at C12-Nashville Facility – Observation Deck location
[*] Fixed the position of the installation for the Servoshell Storage Station at the Parked Ursula location
[*] Placed Airplane Stimulator in a box near the entrance to the sewer, added a personal chest for the player, fixed problems with passability at the Picnic Neutral Zone location
[*] Fixed the inability to select a mine under the bridge using the cursor at the Suspicious Cave location 
[*] Fixed the camera's elevation map at a combat location with a random encounter in a swamp, hid the “flip side” of the location
[*] Fixed the player incorrectly teleporting at the Unknown Place location
[*] Fixed camera bounds, removed the passable zone on the edge of the map that allowed to bypass mines at New Committee Outpost location
[*] Removed the tarpaulin cover from the car that had an incorrect collider at Magellan Station – Warehouse and Parking Lot location
[*] Fixed lighting settings at First Settlers Camp location
[*] Corrected the positions of transition triggers at Barrens location 
[*] Added a minimap to Quicksand location (the one with the stuck Ursula)
[*] Fixed camera bounds and height map for the camera at Phalanx Warehouse location
[*] Fixed the passability at The City location
[*] Fixed camera bounds at Treasure Hunters' Campside location
[/list]
[h1]Quests[/h1]
[list]

[*] Removed the possibility of bribing Victoria Legrand when meeting her projection in the White Fog

[*] Fixed the untimely appearance of the training message when the companions commit a crime
[*] Removed the ability to start a dialogue with dead bandits at the Picnic
[*] Removed the ability to steal hidden weapons from some Black Wing fighters
[*] Fixed the incorrect ability to equip some types of armor with the Neanderthal trait
[*] Fixed infinite reputation gain in dialogue with New Committee merchant Asya de Boer
[/list]
[h1]Effects and Animations[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed displaying death effects from cryolasers, as well as a number of other effects
[*] Fixed animation for Monty James on the Magellan Station – Administration location
[*] Clara Morgan no longer turns to the player during dialogue in the Nashville parking lot
[/list]

[list]

[*] Fixed the ability to ask Taylor Portman for a discount more than once
[*] Fixed a typo on the servoshell armor unequip button
[*] Fixed position of the drive away button in random car events

notes.title: ENCASED - Hotfix 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5d78e68195029eb40857e0aa9c47b1fc0659a512.png[/img]

The recent Encased hotfix released a week ago fixed the most annoying and noticeable bugs that interfered with the comfortable playthrough, and also introduced a number of cosmetic fixes, mostly voice acting and localization. Nevertheless, we received a fairly large number of reports from our players regarding not bugs but the interface, game mechanics and unexpected game behavior. Many of these bugs took a long time to fix, so we included fixes for them in Hotfix 2. 
Overall, the latest update turned out to be much more voluminous than the previous one, and we hope that traveling around the world of the Dome will become even more convenient.

[h3]Attention: fix descriptions may contain plot spoilers![/h3]


[h1]Localization and voiceover[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added narrator voiceover for the main storyline [EN]
[*] Added voiceover for companions: Fox, Crump, Jack, Sparrow and Yoko [EN]
[*] Several localization fixes for Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Significantly improved Chinese (Simplified) localization, wait for further improvements
[*] Fixed a typo in the dialogue with Milo Randall [EN]
[*] Fixed scan records of relics named Seashell and Hook
[*] Fixed typos [RU]
[*] Fixed scan of Rajah Chakraborty's character scan record
[*] Corrected the name and description of the Burning Skeleton (Pyro-Skeleton)
[/list]
[h1]Game Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the option to disable narrator voiceover in dialogues and plot interactions
[/list]
[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a special designation for abilities that can be added to the Quick Access panel (Belt), added a button to quickly add abilities
[*] Improved the displaying of characteristics, taking into account bonuses from traits and starting bonuses of Wings on the final screen of character creation
[*] Added a red border to the context menu for abilities that are considered a crime
[*] Fixed old icons when using actions with progress bar
[*] Fixed incorrect indication of the weapon reload button
[*] Camera shake option is now saved when saving settings
[*] Added the ability to assign camera panning to arrow keys
[*] Fixed the Companion marker on the local map
[*] Fixed displaying of status effect notifications when player is wearing a Servoshell
[*] Improved interface for displaying evidence at location
[*] Fixed the info line for the use of AoE abilities
[*] Added additional types of markers for the local map
[*] Fixed the displaying of the action points bar for a large number of Action Points
[/list]
[h1]Levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed displaying of the combat grid on platforms in the Barrens location during random combat encounters
[*] Fixed camera borders on Magellan
[*] Expanded the area of access to the container at the Nashville Sewers (Act 1) location
[*] Fixed the displaying of flower pots at the Magellan Military Post location
[*] Added decorations for Parked Ursula (Ursula camp)
[*] Added a Servoshell Storage Station to Ursula
[*] Fixed inability to approach the shower stall on Ursula
[*] Fixed locations that could be entered from the Global Map, but cannot be exited in Servoshell
[*] The Pillaged Caravan location has been optimized, interactivity of some items has been fixed
[*] Corrected the name of the gate leading to the Arena in the Fops’ camp
[*] Added camera boundaries at the Barrens location during random combat encounters
[*] Fixed destruction of doors at the Roadside Picnic location
[*] Fixed the owner of the safe at the Temple location
[*] Fixed access to vending machine at Magellan Laboratory
[*] Fixed access to the container at the Kaleidoscope location
[/list]
[h1]Quests[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed inability to install Maelstrom Beacons
[*] Fixed inability to speak with Henrietta Russo when completing the main quest in Act 2
[*] Fixed being able to return the Ejector to Santiago if the player has already completed the main quest “Cooperation Above All Else”
[*] Fixed The Poisoned Well quest playthrough
[*] Fixed the low Brains dialogue during the final meeting with the Maelstrom: now the game responds correctly to using the Beta Helmet
[*] Fixed inability to name a password for a character with Brains equal to 1 on Magellan Reactor Floor
[*] Added a special illustration for the Church and Phalanx ending
[*] Fixed inability to talk to Lenny with a drawn weapon at the Crossroads location
[*] Fixed low Brains character dialogue in the epilogue
[*] City Location: fixed the accessibility of some objects
[*] Removed the ability to receive infinite experience when finishing the quest by talking to Harris Hampton at the Radioactive Graveyard location
[*] Fixed the ending related to killing the leaders of the Carmine Heights faction
[*] Fixed the working of the Lost Caravan quest with a certain sequence of actions
[/list]
[h1]Game Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed New Committee reputation decreases for killing the Afflicted
[*] Fixed the range of the Robot Maintenance ability 
[*] Hog Loader: using the Dismantle ability in the dialogue now adds fatigue, similar to using this ability on other world objects
[*] Hog Loader: Fixed infinite driving experience gain
[*] Attacks on settlements: the level of the attackers is now calculated according to the level of the location
[*] Attacks on settlements: Exploding Robokids removed from the list of attackers
[*] The cooldown of the Thievery ability has been reduced to 1 turn
[*] Fixed the Career Criminal ability
[*] Fixed the displaying of exiting a location by car if the player received Ursula as a vehicle
[*] Fixed description and mechanic of the Third Adrenal perk
[*] Fixed immobilization mechanic for Psi-Stasis
[/list]
[h1]Bugs and Errors[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed inability to remove fatigue when using beds and skipping time
[*] Fixed broken inventory display when some items are present
[*] Fixed the disappearance of the player character's model when using the Holo-5 contraption
[*] Fixed being able to steal the obsolete Matilda pistol from Courtney Reznor
[*] Fixed the appearance of character named Giampiero Stalvardi after completing his quest
[*] Fixed potential bugs in the Tutorial and Give feedback windows
[*] Fixed the work of saves in case of using only special characters in the save name
[*] Fixed bugs when escaping and getting imprisoned
[*] Fixed work of internal reputation with factions when completing main storyline quests
[*] Fixed the ability to use the Resuscitation Kit through the inventory on the Global Map
[*] Waiting window - fixed time updates on the slider
[*] Fixed Wound Up ability working
[*] Fixed potential freeze on title screen
[*] Fixed being able to apply items while in White Space
[*] Fixed potential freeze when moving around the Roadside Picnic location with companions
[*] Fixed inability to fire at hyenas in burst mode
[*] Fixed a bug with repeated dialogue with the character named Ilya Andreev
[*] Fixed freeze when using the elevator in combat on the -3rd floor of Nashville
[/list]
[h1]Sound[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed sounds of electrohyena: now they stop playing after its death
[*] Added sounds for using gates from City to Junktown and vice versa
[*] Added sounds for using Council gates
[*] Fixed events volume in some text random encounters
[*] Fixed sounds of interaction with objects in the Emulator laboratories
[*] Added sound for using the gate in the Maze of Death
[*] Added sounds for random encounters while using Ursula
[*] Added sounds for the Ursula quest
[*] Fixed the sound of the Field Autopsy ability
[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the absence of an icon in the fractal tree (Apple Tree Fractal Crystal) on the Picnic
[*] Fixed an issue where attacking MOBIOS on Magellan's lab floor would render the entire faction hostile
[*] Fixed some death effects
[*] Fixed trade table for Sebastian Van Ulden
[*] Fixed trade table for the Church's weapons merchant
[*] Reduced the amount of dynamite on sale
[*] Increased the number of Sleep Grenades on sale
[*] Removed the ability to create an Electronic Repair Kit
[*] Fixed the displaying of the skeleton in T-pose when removing the Light Alloy Chest Armor from it during the random encounter
[*] Fixed Encased logo
[*] Added new Encased app icon
[/list]





[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: ENCASED - Hotfix 1
notes.content:
[h3]20% discount, new trailer and first post-release hotfix[/h3]

Since the release of Encased, we have been actively collecting your feedback and working on fixing bugs - both critical and minor -  which are impacting the game experience. An updated version is already available for download. If you’ve not got the game yet, we have a release discount of 20%. You can find out more about the final version in our newest trailer.

[previewyoutube=Eyq31os4VDY;full][/previewyoutube]

Below is the list of fixes. Some notes may contain small spoilers.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fatigue recovery increased threefold with all bed types
[*] The frequency of attacks on settlements has been significantly reduced
[*] Corrected the description of the "Dawn" relic
[*] Description of the Atox stimulator has been changed
[*] Added progression for buttstrokes
[*] Fixed being able to equip the Servoshell while in a Servoshell
[/list]
[h1]Quests and Events[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the position of the Maelstrom beacon in the First Settlers Camp
[*] Fixed Influence check in dialogue with Pepper
[*] Fixed completing the "Against All Protocols" quest in case of Monty James’ death
[*] Fixed some checks in the "Help me" quest
[*] Fixed some endings
[/list]
[h1]Transport[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked mechanics of "The Return of Ursula" quest 
[*] Using the car in the prologue now does not add Fatigue to the character and cannot cause death from it
[*] The interaction with the Hog loaders has been temporarily changed
[/list]
[h1]UI/UX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Clicking the "Store All" button now does not close the container window
[*] Clicking the "Store All" button is accompanied by a sound event
[*] Esc button correctly closes game windows
[*] Improved the responsiveness of clicking on buttons in the quick access panel on the right side of the screen
[*] Changed time preview in the time skip window
[/list]
[h1]Translation and Voiceover[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added many missing translations Note: already improved but still being worked on is the version for Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Added Fox voiceover in the Russian version of the game
[*] Voiceover bugs fixed; narrator lines added in the English version of the game
[*] Fixed subtitles in the intro cutscene
[*] Fixed greetings and goodbyes for some characters
[/list]
[h1]Status effects[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the "Restless" status effect
[/list]
[h1]Enemies[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed burning skeleton (added name and description - Pyro-Skeleton)
[*] Fixed incorrect behavior of necroids in combat
[/list]
[h1]Bugs and Errors[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed infinite loading when exiting to main menu in the Nashville cave
[*] Fixed several types of freezes
[*] Fixed access to shelves in Magellan's library
[*] Fixed access to some objects on the Abandoned Film Set
[*] Fixed the ladder leading from the sewers to the destroyed parking lot in Nashville
[*] Fixed freezing when pickpocketing from a character at Concord station
[*] Fixed problems with game launching on systems with some types of oriental calendars
[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the appearance of Clara Morgan in the Unknown Place event
[*] Fixed portraits and appearance of some characters
[*] Added story illustrations
[/list]




[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: Encased is out
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/fddb06237220a6bc3c5eb60d433943a21a325edc.jpg[/img]

We are beyond thrilled to make this announcement: Today Encased - the game to which we have dedicated more than three years of our lives - will be released out of early access. It's hard for us to contain our excitement and describe how important this moment is. 

We’ve been through the Kickstarter campaign, two years of early access, five content patches, millions of hours of early access playtime, hundreds of characters, quests, abilities, and items.

Ahead of us is a leap of faith into the final stage of the most desperate adventure of our lives!


[h1]Do you remember how it all started?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/450d12f3570003175b2e7154536e0845cd3beecb.gif[/img]

In 2017 a very small team of developers decided to create their own game. An RPG with enormous freedom of choice, nearly infinite variability, hundreds of characters and a real influence of player’s choices on the world and story. We knew from the start that we had a long, challenging, but incredibly exciting road ahead of us. And as we developed, it only became more and more difficult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/4311d62aeb4efa0366dabc9b949e5594a409bf68.gif[/img]

Now we are working with a major publisher Prime Matter, but we are still the same independent studio, burning with the idea to create games of our dreams. Our numbers have grown from only a few employees to dozens of people, and the duration of a single full playthrough is around 40 hours!


[h1]Get ready for adventures and more[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/8f3c1f63c6e2669f471dc0d3efbae06664955b36.gif[/img]

During the two years of Early Access, many of you have already played dozens of hours through this phase. The game has already received five content patches that added new mechanics, locations and characters to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5f88f5e8797222931ff75a26979bf3e103716129.gif[/img]

Today, you will uncover the entire world under the Dome, a full story campaign, an updated interface and dozens of endings that will be influenced by your own decisions. And today we're going to tell you about some of the features we're most proud of!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c30971657500a11f48bb98adceb4d140a568fd03.gif[/img]

[i]Encased encourages the most sophisticated ways of playing through the game and is ready for your most extraordinary deeds and decisions. Many, even seemingly insignificant steps of your character will affect the world, story and ending.[/i]

[h3]Tactical turn-based combat[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/37fed6586242ca58d91d05e45335c01716e239e7.gif[/img]

We're die-hard fans of old-school RPGs, so we chose to stick with turn-based battles, where winning is not a matter of clicking your mouse fast enough, but of tactics and strategy. The game mechanics have been changing throughout the early access and our game designers invested a lot of effort into the combat system and balance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/de6468bf1f474f56dc5a1b276ac45fdac39523be.gif[/img]

Encased now features 14 skill trees, over 250 passive and active abilities, 70 perks, and 17 character traits. We did the maths and found that at least 40 unique builds are available to players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7f7a8fba7d307ca25d897ec44a388a4961546195.png[/img]

[h3]Unique playthroughs[/h3]

Remember we promised you that only you can decide how to play the game? The World under the Dome gives you maximum freedom of choice.

Create a character with low intelligence and unlock completely unique dialogues and character reactions, coupled with unconventional ways to die or complete the quest against all the odds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/4b60c107b75bd0bf296f8c422e94532703ca3acc.png[/img]

And if you don't want to talk to anyone, you can hide from others using stealth, strike your enemies from the shadows and go through the whole story as a lone wolf.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/9b1a17c9292f797b00bb59f8b1dce1e430588b85.png[/img]

Unleash your darkest fantasies and start destroying and killing every living thing under the Dome from the very first seconds of the game. Engage in every fight and mercilessly kill every employee of the CRONUS corporation, the game is even ready for a psychopath like you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/156eacfd5af9cf4390599033bf3c37b2749b46b8.jpg[/img]

Believe the best of people? Take on the role of an ardent pacifist, use only non-lethal methods of eliminating opponents and go through the game without spilling a drop of blood. The world under the Dome will remember every action you take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/0df02f266f7293c97d2267b98891e41ee36f7e71.png[/img]

[i]And these are just a few of your future playthrough options. Immerse yourself in the world under the Dome and play your chosen role to the very end![/i]

[h3]Fully voiced main quest with multiple actors[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c40451ea680dbfd54051d0230324418a08c47c9d.png[/img]

Each key character of the world under the Dome is voiced by a professional actor in both English and Russian. Now the adventures have become much more atmospheric and the characters are fully individualised.

[h3]Weapon upgrades, crafting, and survival systems[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/79fc06d196fca9ce4a36c88ac3f2d60322139e67.gif[/img]

We did not strive to create a wasteland survival simulator, but rather a believable living world where in order to stay alive you have to eat, sleep, find or create weapons, try on servoshell armor that protects against many dangers, but is not able to fit through a small manhole or a gap in the fence. Each location and quest can be completed in a variety of ways and it's up to you to decide which one to use.

[h3]Hundreds of characters, companions and factions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/51ffd06bb32d8949c004206195489fa49ce5c912.png[/img]

The world under the Dome has a rich life of its own even without your involvement. Here you will meet interesting characters that can either become your best friends or your worst enemies. Militant factions will try to get you on their side, but whoever's right and wrong is for you to decide. Heroes and dubious characters alike are ready to join your squad. Each of them has their own view on what is going on, as well as their own attitude towards your actions. It's likely that you'll disagree with some of them while others may become your most loyal friends. These people —and not only such— will stand by your character’s side until the end and will possibly play an important role in the game's finale.

[h3]A Story that you can and will shape[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/9690eeac4508ae266e123d8df419636be141fbaa.gif[/img]

From the start Encased has been a game about how people’s courage, wisdom, and hard work can rebuild a decadent civilization from the ashes. But as we all know, not everyone wants to follow the hero's path. We’ve created the story in a way so that the world reacts to every decision you make, and instead of a thriving world in the finale you may see smoking ruins of cities, or a totalitarian empire growing under the Dome, or a state ruled by technocrats, or...

There truly are many endings to Encased, and we want each of you to experience the story that resonates with you.


[h1]We created Encased together with you[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/6fa824f3caeb421dab3af338ec22ad18ed66e43c.jpg[/img]

All the things we mentioned above would remain a dream without the support of our community. We often talk about how players have influenced the creation and development of Encased - and these are not mere words. Every bug report, Steam review, social media comment, game feedback and message you send us directly impacts how we develop the project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/11905782458095c7b8d6f3c2589a33659d465e9a.gif[/img]

The Kickstarter campaign was not the starting point of Encased. Even prior to that we came up with the basic concept of the project, put together the first technical preview, created the concept of Wings and the basis of the universe where humanity discovered the gigantic anomalous Dome. But it wasn't until the campaign began that we realized how many people were willing to support our dream. We realized that our players needed Encased!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/36b15c6fbd8535d05e2a6659b2a5663274453173.jpg[/img]

We sincerely thank the 2,938 Kickstarter backers, the people who believed in us at the earliest stage of development. Pre-orders and every copy sold in early access only strengthened that feeling. The thought of your trust kept us going even in our darkest moments.


[h1]What’s next?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/a6a6e65492241ab4a85cf898ac7d3ad1fbaab944.gif[/img]

Encased has exceeded our expectations. It has a lot more content, mechanics, characters, and points of interest than we intended to make at the beginning of development. Now it's a whole world that lives by its own laws and rules. Tomorrow, when you run the full version of the game for the first time, it may have bugs and flaws. Right now we're getting ready to receive your messages, to address each and every one of them as fast as we can, and to fix, edit and improve all the available content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/c3c7a8d77a442150635795d7e0538d1e9160a251.gif[/img]

You can support us with feedback, send us a bug report, write to us on any social media platforms that will continue to be filled with content. And we will continue to improve the world under the Dome to make your adventures even more exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/b71345d5c0cc6b717313385e976956bb32bfffe5.png[/img]

As soon as the game is released, we'll start creating previously unannounced content that will keep you coming back to the world under the Dome!




[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/921800/

[b]Click Follow to stay updated![/b]

The game continues to evolve so if you want to stay in touch on other channels than Steam you can follow us on social media and visit other cool resources with game updates, information, new artworks and lore pieces.

notes.title: Encased Full Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! Once again, the latest post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly is on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

Over three years in development, two years in Early Access. Encased has changed a lot since the first alpha, and every step of the way your support, criticism, and social media activity kept us going.

In just a couple of days, on September 7, Encased will finally leave Early Access and fully open the Dome to anyone who wants to play the game from start to finish.

Today we're going to tell you about some new Encased mechanics, which we've saved for dessert.

[h1]Servoshell Paint[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/5b72ff89b87a712814443279b4b8bd95ece09e53.gif[/img]

The servoshell armor can be upgraded to four levels and each of them will change the appearance of this death machine. But even this is not the limit of customization. By upgrading the servoshell armor to level four, the player will be able to paint it in the colors of national flags. And it's easy to do, just loot the dead engineers who worked on the paint job.

How will you paint your armor? All options are shown on the gif above.

By the way, servoshell armor painting was one of the social goals on Kickstarter, and without the help of our friendly community would never have made it into the game.

[h1]Ursula[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/a05eed1879991b707a9f8c22eaacfad21712bc9e.gif[/img]

Tired of wandering the endless wasteland on your own two feet? Hurry up to get your hands on the real armored train “Ursula”! It will become your mobile base in the Encased world!

Covered in sand somewhere in the vast wastelands of the Dome, it's waiting to take you to any destination at the speed of light.

[h1]Camps[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/f94ac1d1ef1c013672f6a129d46972f80f22c8f5.gif[/img]

The journey from one settlement to another can take several days of playing time. That's why the full version of Encased on September 7 not only offers players an updated world map, but also the ability to camp anywhere under the Dome.

There you'll be able to grab a bite, have a heart-to-heart talk with your companions, cook food, and heal your wounds.

notes.title: News from the other side of the Dome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! Here’s the latest issue of the post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

Today we want to talk about the news on the other side of the Dome and what awaits the Encased world in the coming weeks.

[h1]Gamescom 2021[/h1]

[previewyoutube=cFNm-Ge0TlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

All week our attention was concentrated on one of the main gaming shows, Gamescom 2021. And we were happy to be directly involved!

Even if the award for the best RPG this year escaped us, we are still grateful that we were placed together with such titans of the genre as Tales of Arise and Elden Ring.

By the way, let us remind you that we released a video about Encased's possible playthrough styles for gamescom. We recommend you watch it!

[h1]Upcoming release[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/a5e40eea2484638277192c5418f3b683f9c0e74b.jpg[/img]

Employees: Encased is less than two weeks away from the full release and our team is working hard to make your first visit to the full version of Encased as enjoyable as possible.

The game has been translated into Russian, English, German, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese. It was also dubbed in English and Russian. Undoubtedly, such an abundance of languages will allow many players to better immerse themselves into the atmosphere of post-apocalyptic Dome.

On 7 September you will be able to wipe out entire settlements, explore all the secrets of the Dome, learn psionics, meet the most unusual inhabitants of the wastelands and, of course, influence the lives of all the CRONUS employees.

[h1]Updated servoshell armor[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/6f8af9910484bea0f152bcd85ac7463ba4c49f16.gif[/img]

In anticipation of the release, our artists have updated all servoshell armor models!

In the days of CRONUS, only the best members of the Black Wing could get their hands on it, but the Incident changed everything. Now anyone can get their hands on this technology.

Find your own servoshell armor in the vast wasteland, and improve it over time. That, together with mastering the piloting skills, will make your hero a death machine.

notes.title: How the community influenced the development of Encased
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! Once again, the latest issue of the post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly is on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

Today we want to talk about how feedback and creativity from players has changed our game.

[h1]Settlers under the Dome[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/ae61b411c4546b37c59618a2ff0c414adbeceacb.gif[/img]

In Encased, players will choose between six unique companions, but did you know that Crump was created by one of the players? Crump is one of the profiles that players sent us through a special site right after the kickstarter campaign. Engineer Yuki Tetsunai was also added to the game this way.

[h1]Character creation and leveling up[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/12494bf9fbdda0a1b71e3925fcd650aeea03ecb7.png[/img]

Balance is a tricky thing, so every content patch we monitored player feedback and made the changes we thought were necessary. There's probably not a single skill left in the game that hasn't been affected in one way or another by player feedback. We hope that our combined efforts will be noticeable at release, and that new players will have a much more balanced game to look forward to.

[h1]UI[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/afb24d979f89c8ae31208408e76be34904be4f03.png[/img]

A user-friendly interface is one of the keys to success of any game. Players should intuitively understand what, where, and how to click for a particular action. Encased is a tribute to Fallout, but the interface doesn't have to stay the same as it was decades ago. Thanks to player feedback and gameplay clips, we've greatly improved the usability. Players no longer have to spend hours looking for the right button.




[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up those closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

tags.feature: In Encased, players will choose between six unique companions, but did you know that Crump was created by one of the players? Crump is one of the profiles that players sent us through a special site right after the kickstarter campaign. Engineer Yuki Tetsunai was also added to the game this way.

tags.balance_change: Balance is a tricky thing, so every content patch we monitored player feedback and made the changes we thought were necessary. There's probably not a single skill left in the game that hasn't been affected in one way or another by player feedback. We hope that our combined efforts will be noticeable at release, and that new players will have a much more balanced game to look forward to.

tags.feature: A user-friendly interface is one of the keys to success of any game. Players should intuitively understand what, where, and how to click for a particular action. Encased is a tribute to Fallout, but the interface doesn't have to stay the same as it was decades ago. Thanks to player feedback and gameplay clips, we've greatly improved the usability. Players no longer have to spend hours looking for the right button.

notes.title: What the full version of Encased has in store for players
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! Once again, the latest issue of the post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly is on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

Today we want to talk about what was added to our release build after the fifth content patch.

[h1]Encased will leave Early Access on September 7![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/ea98bcfcb28a17c9a32375e441b11059fbe6c3dd.png[/img]

Yes, you heard us right. The full Encased release date is September 7th. Mark the day on your calendars and get ready to explore the fully opened Dome in just over a month. Dozens of new quests, new story chapters, multiple endings, weapons, artifacts, and that's just the tip of the content iceberg, that’s awaiting you.

To brighten up your waiting time, we will continue to publish all the most interesting things from the Encased development.

[h1]New Artworks[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/b95b2b8c5dac043a662758812c1e19fe809fbe84.png[/img]

Our artists continue to add new and, most importantly, memorable pictures to the game. You'll see them while loading locations, as well as in text vignettes or even on posters in living rooms. We try to make the world as lively as possible, that is easy to believe and immerse yourself in.

[h1]Updated Combat System[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/146da06346ec5b84326c495e94e70d3d2366af00.gif[/img]

The combat system continues to change and get better, which is why we are so grateful for player feedback! Very soon the game will be more convenient, and most importantly, more fun. Everyone will miss a lot less now in battles.

[h1]Locations[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/18de01fec9ab42062c7ceadf46393677133c820b.png[/img]

Today we want to show you another new location that you'll be able to visit at the game's release this September. It's much more vertical than the previous ones, which will absolutely affect your combat tactics.

notes.title: What are we doing right now?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1a50cdbb94143b138856d6407a55d8979d4a0b34.gif[/img]

Dear subscribers! Once again, the latest issue of the post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly is on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

Today we want to talk about exactly what our team is doing before the game's release this September.

[h1]Locations[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1851c9f77e1795fb7882b1e80dcf90abe7da53ca.gif[/img]

One of the most important parts of any RPG is the locations. Memorable, full of secrets, quests and enemies. Our team polishes both new ones that you'll see for the first time after the full release, and old ones that you've already visited. Even if you've seen everything in the fifth content patch, starting over will be just as fun as the first time!

[h1]Choices and their consequences[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/3f825dee5df24e5955f4b80ef40a818d3de3793c.gif[/img]

[h1]Replayability[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/90bba77987d5cf1022a3cd15ff8e3ba38c6d6350.gif[/img]

notes.content:
Dear subscribers! Once again, the latest issue of the post-apocalyptic CRONUS Weekly is on your screens. Can anyone hear us?

New week - new development news. Our team polishes the already available locations, as well as new ones and also updates and adds new art to the game. We're doing everything we can to make your adventure under the Dome this fall the most memorable experience :)

[h1]New Locations[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/7cfa91c1620bbe8c0d306a6040a92d19de1bd763.png[/img]

There's a funny story behind this location. It was originally planned as a random combat arena, but our level designers ended up doing it so well that we decided to turn it into a normal location. Pretty soon we’ll populate it with unique settlers with their own stories and quests. We really hope you’ll enjoy it!

[h1]Random Encounters[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/519cfa263c1b00d08219996ea8ac58ebb74d1eb0.png[/img]

Random encounters are a pretty big part of Encased and our team goes back to them almost every week. Right now there are already dozens of random story events in the game, and there will be even more in the full version. 

By the way, you don't have to travel around the world map to see some of them. Sometimes a simple rest in the fresh air in the middle of the swamp or somewhere else is enough. By the way, who will try to find all the random events?

[h1]New artworks[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/b2ce196fb96c7d08c5cf3dc724c5029994093d6d.jpg[/img]

Do you recognize it? Yes, this is the Emulator Project Lab in Junktown. This art and many others will be added to the game very soon. Our artists put all their souls into the game and hope that you’ll notice it while playing the game :)

notes.title: Patch 5, hotfix 0.27.604.1055: important updates at the finish line
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/4029a1f14b8bf2af2be0ec9ce28c0120349db1f5.jpg[/img]

A couple of weeks ago, we released content patch 5 and soon after it — the first hotfix to it that eliminated a lot of annoying bugs, discovered by our players. Now it’s time for the second batch of fixes. Most of the team is working on polishing the final Encased build, final version of voice-over and translations so this hotfix released a little bit late. 

In this short update we’ll tell you about the contents inside the second hotfix, news about the Encased release and remind you about the huge announcement from our Koch Media partners. 

As always we’ll start with patch notes:

[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character Menu: Changed icons in the Piloting skill tree
[*] Inventory: Fixed overlapping of items while using filters
[*] Inventory: Fixed freeze when moving certain objects
[*] Inventory: Added icons to display items worn by the player and his companions
[*] Inventory, Barter Window: Fixed handcuffs sticking
[*] Fixed a placeholder in the description of the new variant of the container interfaces
[*] Lots of minor changes in the layout
[*] Fixed issue with scrolling a dialogue window
[*] Bomb timer: fixed window closing
[/list]

[h1]AI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved behavior of characters when searching for a player who is in stealth mode
[*] Fixed characters changing hostility during combat
[*] Fixed the start of combat in the "Crossroads" event when the defeated man notices Lenny
[*] Improved handling of the crime "Being in a restricted area"
[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the "incorporeality" effect when exiting White Space
[*] Fixed the display of quest items in containers
[*] Character Creation Menu: Fixed Muscle leveling while clicking on an empty space
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the ability to discard quest items
[*] Balance: reduced the level of hungry rats in the basement of the cafe at the location "Roadside Picnic”
[*] Balance: reduced the number of action points of the necroid in the basement of the gas station at the location "Roadside Picnic”
[*] Balance: Nashville Station parking lot turrets set to level 3
[*] Balance: sewerage of the "Nashville" station, lowered the level of the group of rats
[*] Balance: sewerage of the "Nashville" station, reduced level of the group of cockroaches
[*] Balance: -3rd floor of the "Nashville" station, lowered the level of a group of infected in the canteen, lowered the level of enemies near the communication room
[*] Balance: "Concord" station, lowered the level of turrets
[*] Balance: Changed the Learning curve of the "Servoshell Armor: Data Gathering System" ability
[*] Roleplaying System: corrected bonus damage of the Action Hero perk
[*] Roleplaying System: fixed the formula for calculating Action Points for non-player characters
[*] Fixed the use of sewer manholes in servoshell armor
[*] Fixed a bug while using the manhole on the -3rd floor of Nashville Station
[/list]

[h1]Text[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the description and logic of the Steam Injectors ability
[*] Fixed a typo in the Tactics difficulty description
[*] Fixed an error in log entry about Don Spencer's death in the Lost Caravan quest
[*] Fixed the Psychonaut perk description
[*] Fixed a typo in the message about a character joining a battle
[*] Fixed the translation of the interface in the dialogue log tab of the PDA
[*] Fixed a placeholder name for the Campbell's Station exit
[*] Fixed the description of "Betamine" medicine
[*] Fixed low intellect character's dialogue with Medcom-72
[*] Fixed low intellect character's dialogue with Marjorie Stovard
[*] Added low intellect character's dialogue with the blue car on the Concord Station
[*] Fixed the display of extra brackets in the tooltip describing another character's move
[*] Fixed the description of the "Analytical Mind" ability
[*] Fixed the description of the "Trasser" ability
[*] Fixed the description of the "Blood Transfusion" ability
[*] Fixed the description of the "Short Circuit" ability
[*] Fixed the description of the "Observation" perk
[*] Fixed tooltips for Grenades, as well as for abilities of Medicine and Piloting skill trees
[/list]

And while you downloading the second hotfix, here is the announcement:
11 June, 12:00 PDT / 15:00 EDT / 20:00 BST / 21:00 CEST our publisher Koch Media [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/921800/view/3034843434627943634]will be streaming.[/url] Everyone is invited!

We left the main announcement regarding the game release for last. Those who follow our social networks already know, so we'll let the rest of you know too: Encased release will happen this fall. Exact date will be announced later.

[h1]New random encounters[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/d896b286bf0d3bc49f9c715305067016432ba512.jpg[/img]

The southern part of the Dome has been opened for exploration to everyone, which means that dozens of unique and unexplored locations await adventurers. One of these locations will be an abandoned camp, full of life just a moment ago. Even the fire is still burning. What happened here? That's what you have to find out.

[h1]Suppressive fire[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/50712dee1187341da50f18f40cf0337ae1f2e4bf.jpg[/img]

With the change in the behavior of the Dome inhabitants, many seemingly useless skills have gained a second wind. For example, Suppression Fire. Each hit of this skill will slow down your target, which will help you catch up and finish off a fleeing enemy before he calls for help.

[h1]Neanderthal[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/172d7c4e9684e12b0b8368e2f13c842c0efb6d34.jpg[/img]

New Committee scientists have also discovered new traits that began to appear in employees under the Dome. For example, the trait "Neanderthal" will increase your damage in close combat, but in return you will have to say goodbye to pants and jackets, because Neanderthals do not wear them.



[h1]Encased community is the most important for us - we are going to follow up those closely for your feedback on the game.[/h1]

notes.title: Patch 5, Hotfix 0.27.526.1806: small, but important fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/79a74a53f316953edd51147315b3eef84dc3ecba.jpg[/img]

Encased content patch 5, which was released the other day, brought a lot of good things to the game: improved optimization, new locations and random encounters and a crime system. We redesigned the game's balance and role-playing system, brought back dialogue for a character with low intelligence and greatly expanded companion interactions.

And although the team is currently busy working on the release version of the game, we found time and prepared a little update for you, fixing annoying imperfections of the fresh patch.

Here are the most notable changes.

[h1]Fixed the settings window[/h1]

Some users have complained that the game settings window would not open and in general did not work correctly. We fixed the problem.

[h1]Almost everywhere the inability to talk to merchants after breaking into a store door is fixed[/h1]

This is not even really a bug: our new crime system has taught the characters to react to the player's illegal actions. Merchants, on the other hand, are characterized by non-standard behavior, so they "broke" and simply refused to talk to the protagonist. At the moment, most vendors work properly, but there is a chance that some are still broken. Just for your information.

[h1]Containers on random encounter locations are now updated regularly[/h1]

A small but nice tweak: purely technically, combat random encounters take place in recurring locations. Previously, the game would forget to update the contents of the containers and a box that you searched once would remain empty when you revisited the location. This annoying issue is now a thing of the past.

[h1]Character banners now display a fatigue scale[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/ce03cdbed62ff0cb64b4e7b77fe63b4f78ad6360.gif[/img]

In case you didn't know: you can play through Encased without killing anyone. The parameter "Fatigue" is responsible for the possibility of non-lethal playthrough. After accumulating 1000 points of fatigue any character (including the main character) will collapse. Now you can monitor the parameter with the fatigue scale located in the character's banner just under the health bar.

[h1]Added customizable backlights for interactable objects[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/1ab34d9bbb8c21ffadf18fbf8c7c71ae910a78fb.gif[/img]

Another little improvement that makes life a lot easier for the player: by pressing the special button (the default is “alt”), you "light up" all the interactive objects at a location. You can turn the stroke on and off, and you can also choose which objects to show.

***

In addition to all of the above, we did the following:

[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed: When pointing a grenade at some objects, its tooltip did not work correctly
[*] Disabled undesirable stroke (F12 key)
[*] Fixed the ability to reassign special Windows keys
[*] Added a dialog log to the character's palmtop
[*] Fixed a problem with sums equalization when trading
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Junktown: Miles Connelly, Henry Hatch, Hector Morales had the "alcohol treatment" status effect and could not be killed
[*] Fixed characters' reaction to a call for help: now those who can't fight don't react to it
[*] Fixed the inability to create items if the skill had an insufficient level and was increased by modifiers
[*] The criminal system now handles killing animals and necroids correctly
[*] Criminal system now handles access to restricted area correctly
[*] Changed the difficulty of the doors at Concord Station
[*] Nashville Sewers: Fixed a freezing fight with a psi cockroach
[/list]
[h1]Graphics and effects[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed display of the “Unconscious rage” status effect
[*] Displayed icons for shotguns
[*] Displayed icons for Baba Yaga grenade launcher
[/list]
[h1]Text[/h1]
[list]
[*] Concord Station: we wrote a dialog with a machine for a character with low intelligence
[*] Changed the text on the epilepsy warning screen
[*] Added description of the "Guts" attribute
[*] Added description of the "Deftness" attribute
[*] Added description of "Brains" attribute
[*] Added description of "Perception" attribute
[*] Changed descriptions for "Detox" and "Ray Desease Treatment" effects
[*] Fixed description of Betamine effect
[*] Fixed the display of penalties and bonuses from "Accuracy" trait in some tooltips
[/list]

notes.title: PRE-RELEASE ENCASED PATCH
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590587/b7a74bc7c516315a7f98b06ce7371e4cbf18bfb4.png[/img]

This time we decided not to write a long text — just watch the attached video, where we talk about how the game has changed over the past few months: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6uQnuLZigv8

For those who are curious about all the changes in the game, we have prepared a detailed list.

[h3]List of changes by category[/h3]
[b]Locations[/b]
[list]
[*] New locations in the southern part of the Dome
[*] New location "Ash Forest"
[*] New location “Chicken Corn Cafe”
[*] New location "Coast"
[*] New location "New Committee Outpost”
[*] New arena for random encounters "Bunker”
[*] New arena for random encounters "Sewers”
[*] Optimized environment for locations
[/list]
[b]Random Encounters[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlocked random encounters of the second story act
[/list]
[b]Craft[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated item creation system
[*] Items available for crafting are divided into categories
[*] More crafting tables
[*] New weapon upgrade system
[*] Weapon enhancement system
[*] Added ability to upgrade unique weapons
[/list]
[b]Crime System[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked the crime system
[*] Evidence visualization added
[*] Reworked the stealth system
[*] Added timer visualization
[*] NPCs can initiate an investigation
[*] Merchants refuse to buy stolen goods
[*] New crimes added: entering forbidden areas, grave robbing
[*] NPCs react differently to the player's illegal actions. Fighters engage in combat, civilians call for help
[*] Unlawful acts lead to reinforcements coming to a location from guards to military in servoshell armor
[*] Killing everyone in the location causes necroids to appear
[/list]
[b]Story and Dialogues[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked playthrough for a character with low intelligence
[*] Added books and journals to learn skills
[/list]
[b]Companions[/b]
[list]
[*] Companion dialogues were expanded
[*] Improved companion AI
[*] Improved squad management system
[*] Shared inventory for the player's squad
[/list]
[b]AI and Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Unprotected locations can be attacked by bandits
[*] Opponents have properly configured stats, weapons, and auras
[*] One time use items moved to the quick access panel
[*] Fixed the progression of enemies' attributes and weapon powers.
[*] Enemies are better at selecting position and targeting, using weapons, and using combat skills.
[/list]
[b]Role-Playing System[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed flaws in the skill system. The player can level up a skill up to 150 and get additional bonuses, which are added to the maximum value.
[*] Added new skills
[*] Fixed bugs in previously available skills
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked sound effects
[*] Minor visual fixes
[*] Combat animations updated
[/list]
